title: The Seven People in the Waiting Room
notes: Detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro, Ran) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ file got the culprit right (stationmaster 'Kikuo Inagaki' = s2 = murderer) but modeled everything as generic 'knows' edges plus three reified event nodes, and missed most of the cast that matters: it never named the assemblyman Yuhara Shonosuke or Yamazaki Kozo's son (the actual motive source -- Kozo is the impersonating 'stationmaster,' his real name is Yamazaki Kozo, a construction worker avenging his son's frame-up and suicide, which the old file's flat victim/suspect list doesn't capture at all), never modeled the real bound stationmaster he impersonated, and collapsed the note-writing subplot (Masako Ueno secretly wrote and tore the warning note from the station's welcome sign, which is why she was later attacked in the blackout) into a single vague clue about 'the impersonator's identity.' The old file also lumped all alibi locations into one 'Ofumoto Station' node; the transcript actually distinguishes waiting room / hot spring bath / back of station / platform / souvenir shop / outside-in-the-storm, which this rebuild restores since it's exactly the substrate needed for `was_at` alibi-checking. case_type: murder.
